system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Skills are reusable procedures injected into worker system prompts.
system_prompt_style.note: Working memory layers and skills assembled into prompts; code not in bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: File** — read, write, and list files with auto-created directories

context_compaction.note: Output scrubbing is not pruning; other compaction not shown.

observation_format.evidence_quote: headless Chrome automation with accessibility-tree refs. Navigate, click, type, screenshot, manage tabs

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Rig](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig)** v0.31 — agentic loop, tool execution, hooks

tool_count.note: Tool registry source not in bundle.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: File** — read, write, and list files with auto-created directories
edit_primitive.note: Edit tool schema not in bundle; other primitives unknown.

tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schema source not in bundle.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Connect workers to external [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) servers for arbitrary tool access

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Events are recorded as they happen

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Autonomy runs on a task state machine linked to goals, not a heartbeat.json.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A channel never executes tasks or searches memories directly. It branches to think, spawns workers to act, and stays responsive.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Branch might spawn a worker for heavy tasks

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Tasks the autonomy channel creates land in `pending_approval`. Nothing runs autonomously until you approve it.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: State lives in tasks. Progress notes go on the task itself.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Spacebot's memory is a typed, graph-connected knowledge system in SQLite and LanceDB.
long_term_memory.note: Skills written from experience; SQLite memory graph coded episodic_db (closest).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: After a crash, the next wake reads task metadata and picks up where things left off.

self_verification.note: No verification config surface in bundle.

retry_policy.note: Cron circuit breaker after 3 failures is not task retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: It picks the most important ready task, executes it with full tool access, and exits.
termination_condition.note: Reflection has capped turn budget; caps not verified in code.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Simple user messages are downgraded to cheaper models by a sub-millisecond prompt scorer with no external calls.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Shell** — run arbitrary commands with configurable timeouts

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: On Linux, [bubblewrap](https://github.com/containers/bubblewrap) creates a mount namespace where the filesystem is read-only except the agent's workspace.
execution_isolation.note: Host subprocess with OS sandbox (bubblewrap/sandbox-exec); Docker deploy optional.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: file tools reject paths outside the agent's workspace. Symlinks that escape are blocked.

network_policy.note: Only browser SSRF protection mentioned; sandbox network config not in bundle.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Per-channel permissions** — guild, channel, and DM-level access control, hot-reloadable

tracing.evidence_quote: Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint. Opt-in via the `metrics` cargo feature flag.
tracing.note: Worker transcripts and tool calls stored (migrations); no OTel seen.

guardrails.evidence_quote: all tool secret values are redacted from worker output before it reaches channels or LLM context
guardrails.note: Prompt Guard 2 input classifier (with Spacedrive), SSRF blocking, workspace path rejection.

target_domain.evidence_quote: An AI agent for teams, communities, and multi-user environments.

open_source.evidence_quote: FSL-1.1-ALv2, [Functional Source License](https://fsl.software/), converting to Apache 2.0 after two years.
open_source.note: Source-available, not OSI until conversion; closest value.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint works
